I believe many people enjoy living, it\'s just that it\'s not my case and I don\'t feel it will ever be. All I experience are endless days of subjective perceived suffering, self harm and suicide thoughts, detachment from the outer world and immense guilt for feeling this way. If only I could transfer that what has been "given" to me, the "gift of life," time being alive before eternal nothingness which I will endure no matter what, to some other person, who could experince joy I\'m not meant for experiencing, before facing the same eternity devoided of life as I will.', "Just kill me already. This is a neverstopping day and night cycle devoided of purpose, tainted by mental agony, everlasting wish to be dead, for this state of existence to cease to be. I don't think I'm making much sense.
